# The ToolBox

> The ToolBox is a trade lifestyle membership app for Australia. For $4.99/mo (Founding 500 rate), members get real discounts at 50+ partner brands across workwear, supplements, fitness, recovery, food and tech, shown in the app as a digital membership card or promo code and redeemable in-store or online.

The ToolBox App Pty Ltd is based in Melbourne, VIC, Australia.

## Membership

- Monthly Pro: $4.99/mo (Founding 500 rate), cancel anytime.
- Annual Gold Saver: $49.99/yr (Founding 500 rate), saves $10/yr over monthly.
- Founding 500: the first 500 members lock in $4.99/mo for life, even after the rate goes up for new members.
- [Pricing](https://thetoolboxapp.com.au/#pricing)

## How it works

1. Browse the app - search 50+ partner brands by category: workwear, supplements, fitness, food, golf and more.
2. Find a deal near you - locate partner stores on the map, or grab the online member code for stores you can't visit in person.
3. Redeem your discount - reveal the promo code, show staff before payment in-store, or paste it at checkout online.
4. Track every dollar saved - the app totals every deal redeemed so members can see exactly what their membership is worth.

## For vendors

Brands can apply to become a ToolBox partner and get their offer in front of members living the trade lifestyle. Every partner is manually vetted before being added, no token 5% deals.

- [Partner with us](https://thetoolboxapp.com.au/vendor)
- [Browse current partners](https://thetoolboxapp.com.au/vendors)

## Frequently asked questions

**What is The ToolBox?**
The ToolBox is a trade lifestyle membership app for Australia. For $4.99/mo, members get real discounts at 50+ partner brands across workwear, supplements, fitness, recovery, food and tech.

**How does membership work?**
Download the app, pick Monthly Pro ($4.99/mo) or Annual Gold Saver ($49.99/yr), and your digital membership card unlocks every partner deal straight away. No lock-in contract on the monthly plan.

**How do vendors join?**
Fill out the partner application on the vendor page and the team will be in touch. Every partner is manually vetted to make sure the discount is worth a member's time before it goes live in the app.

**How do I use my discount?**
Once you're a member, open the app and show your digital membership card in-store at any partner vendor, or use the provided promo code for online orders.

**Is there a lock-in contract?**
No. Monthly Pro is cancel-anytime. The Annual plan offers the best value but members are never forced to stay.

**Which brands are included?**
50+ vendors and growing, across tools, workwear, supplements, recovery and more. The full list is inside the app.

**Can I use it anywhere in Australia?**
The ToolBox is actively scoping out vendors across every state in Australia.

**How do I know the discounts are legit?**
Every vendor is personally vetted and onboarded. The ToolBox only partners with brands offering genuine, meaningful savings, not token 5% deals.
